contexts.text: See Doctrine.
How the doctrine began to be falsified and adulterated. Treated of.
When a false principle is confirmed by truths, they become truths falsified, because they are defiled by the essence of the principle.
Midian, in the opposite sense, = those who falsify truths. The falsifications are signified by the witchcrafts in their hand.
The spoil, which was gold, silver, cattle, = the truths which were falsified.
In (, , ) each and all things are representative of the falsification of truth, and of punishment on that account.
Judah's lying with his daughter-in-law involves and represents the damnation of truth falsified from evil; for whoredom, in the Word, everywhere = the falsification of truth.
That the truths and goods of doctrinal things from the Word were falsified. Signified.
See Ammon.
That the affections of good and truth were perverted by falsifications. Signified.
Doctrines from falsified truths in the Natural where there were estranged scientifics. Signified.

The second degree (of the removal and deprivation of the influx of truth and good) is described by the waters of Egypt being turned into blood, by which is signified that truths themselves were falsified.
That the Scientific of truth would be extinguished by falsification. Signified.
What the falsification of truth is, shall be illustrated by some examples. (Nine examples given.)
There is not a single truth which cannot be falsified, and the falsification confirmed by reasonings from fallacies.
Profaned truth is falsity conjoined with truth; and falsified truth is falsity not conjoined but adjoined to truth, and ruling over truth.
The Egyptians = those who falsify truths.

Falsification becomes total when falsity begins to reign, for the man then lives according to the evil innate and acquired... and as the truths of faith prohibit such things, he abhors them, and when he abhors truths, he rejects them... and if he cannot reject, he falsifies them.
Under Evil, see this reference. AC 7344:2. AC 8087. AC 8094. AC 8149. AC 9298:2.
That their falsifiers fashioned the like. Signified.
If the affection of these loves has the dominion, it draws truth over to its own side, and so falsifies it... Hence it is, that the evil, so far as they can, falsify the truths of faith.
That truths cannot be applied to mere falsities, that is, cannot be falsified by mere falsities. Signified, Explained.
The end of the state after truths were falsified. Signified.

That the reasonings should not be from falsified truths, but from mere falsities. Signified. The reason is, that reasonings from falsified truths are at last turned into blasphemies against truth and good; and, moreover, real truths reject falsification from themselves; for they cannot be together with falsities... Hence it is, that after a man has falsified truths, he at last utterly denies them; otherwise falsities would have dominion over truths...
The damnation of faith separated from charity is the damnation of the falsified truth and adulterated good which are of faith; for when truth has been falsified, it is no longer truth, but falsity...
From the first-born of Pharaoh that is about to sit upon his throne = the falsified truths of faith which are in the first place.
The falsified truths of faith which are in the first place are those which are acknowledged as essentials. Enumerated.
Even to the first-born of the handmaid who is behind the mills = the falsified truths of faith which are in the last place. Explained.
What is leavened shall not be eaten = that nothing falsified shall be appropriated.

That which is falsified, which is signified by what is leavened; and falsity, which is signified by leaven, differ in this: that what is falsified is truth applied to confirm evil, and falsity is everything which is against truth.
For by applications to evil, all truths whatever are falsified. Example(s).
Under Adultery, see this reference. DFaith 49. DP 233:10. DP 233:11. LJPost 135.
This miracle represents that the falsified good of the Church becomes good by means of truth from the Word... The wild gourds from a vine of the field = falsification.
That the falsified good of faith shall not be conjoined. Signified.
Under Disease, see this reference.
The truths with those who are in evil are truths falsified, which are dead.
Under Falsity, see this reference. AC 8094. CL 243.

The falsification of truth is effected in three ways. First: if a man is in evil of life, and acknowledges the truths of doctrine; for then evil is within the truths, and evil falsifies truth; for evil dissipates from truths what is celestial and Divine, and implants what is infernal; hence comes falsification. Secondly: if a man is first in truths as to doctrine, and afterwards accedes to the falsity of another doctrine; which takes place only with those who are in evil of life; because evil has an appetite for falsity, and eagerly seizes upon it for truth. Thirdly: if a man who is in evil as to life, and in falsities as to doctrine, seizes upon the truths of another doctrine, he, also, falsifies truths; because he does not acknowledge the truths for the sake of truth, but for the sake of something of gain, of honours, or of reputation. All these falsifications are in the Word called whoredoms and harlotries; because... unlawful conjunctions are meant by whoredoms. Illustrated.
They who have applied Divine truths to their own loves, and have thus falsified them, love urinous things, because urinous things correspond to the delights of such love.
(References to passages on the subject of the falsification of truth.)
The harlot with a dead horse signified the falsification of the Word by many at this day, by which all the understanding of truth has perished.

If there is anything in the understanding which does not agree with the will, when the man is left to himself... he either casts out the truth which is in the understanding, or compels it to be one by falsification.
See Elevate.
If truths from the Word in the second degree are taken to it to form it, these truths are falsified from the first degree, which is the love of evil...
If man's Own intelligence then sees truth, it either turns itself away, or it falsifies the truth. Explained.
If it is asked, How much of the Word have they falsified?... The answer is, that they have falsified the whole Word...
That thus all the truths of the Word were completely falsified. Signified. AR 410.
As the Jewish Church had falsified all the truths of the Word... they gave Him vinegar to drink mingled with gall.
The extinction of spiritual life with many by the falsified truths of the Word. Signified.
The reason bitter = falsified, is that the bitter of wormwood is meant; and wormwood = infernal falsity.
The truths of the Word falsified, by which they induce a stupor. Signified.
The tail = all its confirmations in the aggregate, which are from the Word; thus the truths of the Word falsified.
Cunning falsifications of the Word, by which for a short time they darken and fascinate the understanding, and thus deceive and captivate. Signified.
Stings in their tails = cunning falsifications of the Word; stings = cunning; and tails, the truths of the Word falsified.
If that doctrine... were to be received by any others... before the dragon is cast out, it would be rejected... and if it should not be rejected, still it would be falsified, nay, profaned.
That the acknowledgement that He alone is the God of Heaven and earth... is disagreeable and difficult, owing to falsifications. Signified.
The chief of these falsifications are...
Under Diadem, see this reference. AR 540. AR 540:2. AR 570.
That by falsifications of the truths of the Word they have discarded from the Church all spiritual Knowledges of good and truth. Signified.
The tail, where it treats of those who have confirmed heretical things by the Word, = the truths of the Word falsified.
See Faith alone. AR 686.

The angelic Spirits then conversed together concerning the falsification of the Word; and they agreed in this: that to falsify the Word is to take truths from it, and apply them to confirm falsities. Example(s).

Here, the power of falsifying many truths of the Word is signified; but there, the falsification of them all; for the laity are able to do it, but do not. For they who are in falsities and in the faith of them, are against truths; and therefore when they see truths in the Word, they falsify them.
That they speak, teach, and write from the Word as if it were the Lord's Divine truth, and yet it is truth falsified. Signified.
His number is six hundred and sixty-six = that the quality is this: that every truth of the Word has been falsified by them.
That they falsify the goods and truths of the Word, and imbue the life with them falsified. Signified.
The wine of the anger of God mingled unmixed = the truth of the Word falsified.
Hence it is, that those who have falsified truths by applying them to the delights of the love of self and of the world, are not able afterwards to turn themselves to truths.
The falsification or extinction of truths. Signified.
That truths would be falsified, and thereby extinguished. Signified.
Thus are the truths of the Word falsified by all those who are in the conceit of their Own intelligence from the love of self.
Because the truths of the Word are falsified. Signified.
The Knowledges of truth falsified, and thus turned into falsities. Signified.
This Book does not treat of those who deny truths, but of those who falsify them...

The Knowledges of truth and good from the Word are falsified by those who acknowledge the Word, but apply it to favour their own loves and to favour the principles which are from their Own intelligence; for they thus turn the truths of the Word into falsities...
The reason they who falsify the truths of the Word by interpretations to confirm evils of life, turn themselves away from Heaven and turn themselves to Hell...
Falsifications of the Word by reasonings from fallacies. Signified.
Spiritual life is extinguished by perversions of good and falsifications of truth...

The adulteration of good, and the falsification of truth. Signified. Good is adulterated when good is called evil, and when evil is called good; and truth is falsified when darkness is put for light and light for darkness; darkness = falsities, and light, truths.
To break through the wall = to falsify, and thus to destroy the truths which protect the Church.
Under Devastate, To, see this reference.
Under Dragon, see this reference.
The falsification and adulteration of all the truths of the Word. Signified.
How it is that the Sensuous falsifies and adulterates the truths of the Word. Explained.
Thus is falsified the truth that the sun does not move, but the Earth; but it is not falsified when the Rational enlightens the matter.
From this it is evident how innumerable things in the Word are falsified and adulterated...

For truths are extinguished and destroyed when they are falsified and adulterated. Truths falsified and adulterated are greater falsities than those from any other origin; for falsities from any other origin do not so completely extinguish and destroy truths...
Host things in the sense of the letter of the Word are appearances of truth, which, if confirmed as genuine truths, are falsified; and falsified truths are falsities.

The sons of the sorceress, and the seed of the adulterer = falsities from the falsified and adulterated Word... The Word is said to be falsified when its truths are perverted; and it is said to be adulterated when its goods are perverted, and also when its truths are applied to the loves of self.
Under Blaspheme, see this reference. AE 778:2. AE 778:3. AE 778:9. AE 794. AE 797. AE 1027.

Apparent goods and truths are those which are adulterated and falsified; and they are said to be adulterated and falsified when they are explained contrary to genuine goods and truths; for in this case Heaven removes itself...

Who and of what quality (those solifidians) are who so falsify the Word as to completely close Heaven against themselves; who and of what quality they are who do not so falsify the Word as to close Heaven against themselves; and who and of what quality they are who do not falsify the Word. Explained. AE 798:2. AE 798:8. AE 800:2.
If the sense of the letter is falsified to the destruction of the spiritual sense, Heaven is closed.

They who separate faith from good works in both doctrine and life, falsify all the quality of Divine truth, or all things of the Word... (For) they exclude love and charity... and therefore not only falsify those things of the Word where it teaches of love to God and of love towards the neighbour, but also those places where works, deeds, working, and doing are mentioned; and when these are falsified, all things of the Word are falsified; for the other things of the Word, which are called its truths, live from the things previously mentioned... Moreover, everywhere in the Word there is the marriage of good and truth... and therefore when the good is taken away, the truth which remains is falsified; and truth falsified is falsity.
Under Beast, see this reference. AE 932. AE 998.

The Word in the letter consists of appearances of truth... and therefore when any falsity is confirmed by the appearances of truth which correspond to genuine truths, the Word is falsified; and the falsification of the Word can only exist through reasonings from the natural man. Signified.
Hence it is, that... it is reasonings from the natural man by which the Word is falsified; for the Word cannot be falsified without reasonings from the natural man.
Those not defiled with women = those who have not falsified the truths of the Word.
They who are in truths from good cannot falsify truths...
The wine of the anger of whoredom = the falsification of truth: and falsified truth adulterates good.
How infernal and injurious it is to falsify the Word to the destruction of the Divine truth and the Divine good in the Heavens. Explained.
These cannot do otherwise than falsify the Word to the destruction of its genuine truth.

The devastation of the Church as to Divine truth... is effected by the falsification of the Word; for when the Word is explained in favour of earthly loves, and to confirm falsities of doctrine, the Church is vastated... AE 914:end.
The falsification of the Word as to all spiritual truth, and the consequent damnation from there being no... charity. Signified. AE 923.
The falsification of the Word is also a production of falsity from evil; for evil falsifies...
The Divine truths of the sense of the letter of the Word are said to be falsified when they are perverted to the destruction of interior Divine truth...
Because they have falsified the truths of the Word and of doctrine from the Word. (For) blood = Divine truth, and to shed it = to do violence to Divine truth, which is to falsify it. AE 976.
The reason truth falsified is the falsity of evil, is that evil falsifies truth.
To bear false witness... in the inmost sense, = to falsify the truth and good of the Word...
Under Drunk, see this reference. AE 1035:2.
Under Babel, see this reference.
Divine truth falsified by satans stinks in the Spiritual World like the mire of the streets.
Truths do not falsify the Word, wherever it may be read...
Trinity. 8. The confirmation of a trinity of Persons... has falsified the whole Word.
It is allowable to confirm truths by the Word, wherever we please, ... the Word is not falsified thereby.
